name: toast
description: A source-owned Toast notification system for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Only the toast region's fixed viewport placement is styled by default (structural, not cosmetic); individual toast cards keep the primitive's own unstyled composition, matching this registry's existing many-parts-unstyled precedent for Select/Combobox. A full default visual style for Toast itself is M4's job.
documentation.accessibility: Each `Toast` is `role="alertdialog"` wrapping a `role="alert"` live region, per the WAI-ARIA APG "alert" pattern (`packages/adico-primitives/src/toast.rs`); `ToastProvider` manages a shared notification queue with no APG pattern of its own.
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling beyond a global keydown listener used for dismissal; individual toast dismissal is otherwise pointer/timer-driven (auto-dismiss timer per toast).
